organization: European Organisation for the Exploitation of Meteorological Satellites
sensor_type: SEVIRI (Meteosat MSG geostationary), AVHRR / ASCAT / MHS (Metop polar-orbiting)
revisit_time: 15 minutes (Meteosat MSG SEVIRI); 12-hour repeat (Metop polar orbit)
description: EUMETSAT operates Europe's meteorological satellites providing continuous atmospheric and meteorological monitoring. For flood monitoring, EUMETSAT supplies high-frequency precipitation estimates, soil moisture data, and severe weather products through the Hydrology Satellite Application Facility (H SAF), which are essential for flood early warning and upstream rainfall monitoring.

flood_detection.notes: Meteorological sensors do not detect surface flooding directly; precipitation data supports upstream cause monitoring rather than flood surface detection

flood_extent_assessment.notes: Coarse spatial resolution (3-25km) insufficient for flood extent delineation; atmospheric focus

cloudy_conditions.notes: Microwave precipitation retrievals from Metop (MHS, AMSU) are cloud-penetrating; geostationary SEVIRI IR imagery monitors storm systems regardless of cloud cover

night_operations.notes: IR and microwave instruments operate 24/7 independent of solar illumination; continuous precipitation monitoring day and night

emergency_response.notes: H SAF near-real-time precipitation products feed into EFAS early warning; 15-minute MSG updates enable real-time tracking of extreme rainfall events

strengths: 15-minute precipitation estimates from geostationary Meteosat MSG SEVIRI
Hydrology SAF (H SAF) delivers operational near-real-time precipitation and soil moisture
Continuous 24/7 monitoring over Europe, Africa and the Atlantic
Essential upstream rainfall data for river flood early warning (feeds EFAS)
Long operational record since 1977 enabling climatological flood context
Global coverage via Metop polar-orbiting satellites
limitations: Spatial resolution (3-25km) too coarse for detailed flood extent mapping
Primarily meteorological focus; surface flood detection requires complementary SAR/optical data
Requires user registration and data service agreement for full access
Precipitation retrieval has uncertainty in complex orographic terrain
products: H SAF H60 - instantaneous rain rate (Metop microwave)
H SAF H90 - accumulated precipitation analysis
RGB cloud composites and severe convection products
recommended_for: Upstream rainfall monitoring for river flood early warning
Real-time precipitation tracking during active storm events
Soil saturation assessment before and during flood events
Feeding hydrological models and EFAS with real-time precipitation forcing
